title: the lifesteal
description: This is a lifesteal thing that you can put on servers acts just like lifesteal just slightly different
body:
This lifesteal offers amazing things such as
-stealing hearts from players max hearts go up to 25!
-if you get down to 0 hearts you will be stuck in place at 0 0 0
-custom recipes for hearts
-custom recipes for revival beacons

use trigger to claim hearts or to revive somone

if you revive it will shout REVIVE in chat if you have the special beacon and the owner will have to be on to set the scoreboard /scoreboard players set (player) takeemal to above 0 whatever there choice is and then clear the beacon from their inventory
